description:
Mailbox access is granted from three independent sources, merged at access-check time. Admin explicit grants and explicit denies win over all auto-provisioned sources.

Schema:
  mailbox_grants(identity_id FK, mailbox_id FK, permission, source, explicit_deny bool, granted_at, granted_by, PRIMARY KEY (identity_id, mailbox_id, permission, source))
  group_mailbox_grants(group_name, mailbox_id FK, permission, PRIMARY KEY (group_name, mailbox_id, permission))

permission values: read | write | send-as | send-on-behalf | admin
  send-as: From header shows mailbox address only, no trace of identity
  send-on-behalf: From shows 'Alice Smith on behalf of security@kubernetes.io'
  These are orthogonal to read/write.

source values: admin | email-claim | group-claim | mailboxes-claim | scim | scim-group

Three auto-provisioning sources (all evaluated at login, union of permissions):
  1. email claim → look up mailbox_addresses → grant personal mailbox access
  2. groups claim → look up group_mailbox_grants → grant shared mailbox access
     groups claim key is configurable per provider (cognito:groups, groups, etc.)
  3. stoa_mailboxes custom claim → direct mailbox_id list → grant directly

Precedence:
  explicit_deny (admin) → veto, wins over everything
  explicit admin grant → sets permissions exactly
  auto-provisioned (sources 1-3) → union of all matching grants

Access check:
  SELECT permission FROM mailbox_grants
  WHERE identity_id=? AND mailbox_id=? AND explicit_deny=FALSE
  UNION
  SELECT gmg.permission FROM group_mailbox_grants gmg
  JOIN session_groups g ON g.group_name = gmg.group_name
  WHERE gmg.mailbox_id=?
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mailbox_grants
                    WHERE identity_id=? AND mailbox_id=? AND explicit_deny=TRUE)

session_groups derived from JWT claims at auth time, held in session, not persisted.

Grant table evaluated on every request — admin revocation is immediate regardless of token age. IdP group membership changes take effect within one access token TTL (typically 15 min) on next token refresh.
title: design: mailbox grants — three-source provisioning with admin override
